summary.text: Derell Wilson has represented Connecticut's 46th House District since January 2023 and is the Democratic candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

paragraphs.text: He lives in Norwich, where he has served as an alderman.
He has also served as president of the Norwich NAACP Robertsine Duncan Youth Council and of the state NAACP Youth and College Division.
